cooked: A useful regression test would exercise both graph states: the duplicated node ID is absent before the announcement, and it already exists. The first reaches the duplicate insertion path described here; the second checks that rejection doesn’t depend on whether the node was previously learned. It’d also be worth asserting the malformed announcement never reaches gossip_store, then restarting from that store to catch persistence-order regressions.
